strings.zh: 您好,欢迎来到水都群岛精灵中心。
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands Pokémon Center.

strings.zh: 你见过会说人话的喵喵吗？
strings.en: Have you ever seen a Meowth that can{NEWLINE}talk like a human?

strings.zh: 其实我们水都群岛{NEWLINE}原来就有一只会说人话的喵喵。{CLEAR}它原本只是一只普通的野生喵喵,{CLEAR}但后来它迷恋上了一只家养的喵喵。{SCROLL}但这只家养的喵喵{NEWLINE}只喜欢跟人类在一起,{CLEAR}并不喜欢野生的喵喵。{SCROLL}于是野生喵喵为了得到美猫的芳心,{NEWLINE}就开始努力学习人话,{CLEAR}最终竟然真的被它给学会了！{SCROLL}什么？我怎么知道的？{SCROLL}我就是当时{NEWLINE}教那只喵喵学说话的语文老师啊。
strings.en: Actually, the Alto Mare Islands used to{NEWLINE}have a Meowth that could talk like a{CLEAR}human. It was just an ordinary wild{CLEAR}Meowth, but then it fell for a{CLEAR}pet Meowth.{SCROLL}But that pet Meowth only liked being{NEWLINE}around people. It didn’t care for{CLEAR}wild Meowth.{SCROLL}So to win that beauty’s heart, the wild{NEWLINE}Meowth started working hard to learn{CLEAR}human speech. And in the end, it{CLEAR}actually learned to talk!{SCROLL}What? How do I know?{SCROLL}I was the language teacher who taught{NEWLINE}that Meowth to talk!
strings.notes: Continuity: the talking Meowth backstory (0441 Meowth/Meowzie arc).

strings.zh: 哦？这世界上居然还有{NEWLINE}别的喵喵会说人话？{CLEAR}搞不好是跟我们水都群岛{CLEAR}原来那只会说人话的喵喵{CLEAR}是同一只哦。
strings.en: Oh? There’s another Meowth in the world{NEWLINE}that can talk like a human? Maybe it’s{CLEAR}the same one that used to live here in{CLEAR}the Alto Mare Islands.

strings.zh: 来到水都群岛后,看到这里的{NEWLINE}石板路面、岸边灯火、城间河道,{CLEAR}就让我忍不住想创作一首曲子{CLEAR}歌颂这里的美丽风光。{CLEAR}不过曲子的名字叫什么好呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ever since I came to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands, the stone-paved streets, the{CLEAR}lights along the shore and the canals{CLEAR}between the buildings have made me want{CLEAR}to write a piece of music praising the{CLEAR}beautiful scenery. But what should I{CLEAR}call it?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: #4-#12: composer naming his piece; #6 is the accepted answer.

strings.zh: 水之都市
strings.en: City of Water

strings.zh: 谜之少女
strings.en: Mysterious Girl

strings.zh: 海之花园
strings.en: Garden of the Sea

strings.zh: 我不知道,还是你自己想吧
strings.en: No idea. Think of one yourself
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I don’t know. Think of one yourself'

strings.zh: 水之都市吗？{NEWLINE}感觉表意太直白了,{CLEAR}不够有美感。
strings.en: City of Water? That feels too on the{NEWLINE}nose. Not poetic enough.

strings.zh: 海之花园吗？{NEWLINE}感觉形容的不像一之岛的风光,{CLEAR}更像是五之岛的。
strings.en: Garden of the Sea? That doesn’t sound{NEWLINE}like One Island’s scenery. It sounds{CLEAR}more like Five Island.

strings.zh: 没错,就是这个感觉。{NEWLINE}水都群岛美丽而神秘,{CLEAR}就像一位初次见面的谜之少女！{SCROLL}非常感谢你帮我想出了这么棒的曲名,{NEWLINE}这个送给你作为感谢吧。
strings.en: Yes, that’s exactly the feeling! The{NEWLINE}Alto Mare Islands are beautiful and{CLEAR}mysterious, like a mysterious girl{CLEAR}you’ve only just met!{SCROLL}Thank you so much for helping me come{NEWLINE}up with such a wonderful title. Please{CLEAR}take this as thanks.

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我想出了这么棒的曲名,{NEWLINE}我这次一定可以作出一首{CLEAR}让人印象深刻的曲子！
strings.en: Thank you for helping me come up with{NEWLINE}such a wonderful title. This time, I’m{CLEAR}sure I can write an{CLEAR}unforgettable piece!

strings.zh: 我以前只听说过水都的大名,{NEWLINE}却从来没有亲眼见过。{SCROLL}如今来到这里才知道{NEWLINE}水都真的名不虚传,{CLEAR}当真是河道纵横的水乡。
strings.en: I’d only ever heard of Alto Mare’s{NEWLINE}fame. I’d never seen it with my{CLEAR}own eyes.{SCROLL}Now that I’m here, I know Alto Mare{NEWLINE}really lives up to its name. It truly is a{CLEAR}town of water, crisscrossed{CLEAR}with canals.

strings.zh: 能来水都群岛旅游,真的好开心啊！
strings.en: I’m so happy I got to come to the Alto{NEWLINE}Mare Islands on vacation!

strings.zh: 打电话给哥哥的话,{NEWLINE}他会告诉你存放精灵的{CLEAR}箱子的情况哦！
strings.en: When you call my brother, he can tell{NEWLINE}you about the PC Boxes where you{CLEAR}store your Pokémon!

strings.zh: 三之岛原来是水都群岛的工业区。{NEWLINE}出于保护环境的考虑,{CLEAR}精灵联盟将造船业迁到了别处,{CLEAR}并准备把三之岛改造成{CLEAR}纪念造船史的景区。{SCROLL}我便是受雇来进行景区改造的工程师。{NEWLINE}可是当我到达三之岛的时候{CLEAR}却被那里的暴走族给揍了一顿{CLEAR}然后扔进了水里。{SCROLL}真没想到水都群岛这么美丽的地方{NEWLINE}居然也会有这种暴徒。
strings.en: Three Island used to be the industrial{NEWLINE}zone of the Alto Mare Islands. To{CLEAR}protect the environment, the{CLEAR}Pokémon League moved the shipbuilding{CLEAR}industry elsewhere and plans to turn{CLEAR}Three Island into a tourist spot{CLEAR}honoring its shipbuilding history.{SCROLL}I’m the engineer hired to do the{NEWLINE}conversion. But when I got to Three{CLEAR}Island, the bikers there beat me up and{CLEAR}threw me in the sea.{SCROLL}I never imagined a place as beautiful as{NEWLINE}the Alto Mare Islands would have thugs{CLEAR}like that.

strings.zh: 你不是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吗？{NEWLINE}能在这遇见你真是太好了。{SCROLL}拜托你帮我赶走三之岛的{NEWLINE}那些暴走族好不好,拜托了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Aren’t you League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?{NEWLINE}I’m so glad I ran into you here.{SCROLL}Could you please drive off those bikers{NEWLINE}on Three Island for me? Please!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 是太忙了吗……{SCROLL}如果你什么时候有空,{NEWLINE}请一定要来帮帮我,拜托了！
strings.en: Are you too busy...?{SCROLL}If you ever have time, please come help{NEWLINE}me. I’m begging you!

strings.zh: 太好了,虽然暴走族都是些{NEWLINE}很凶恶的训练家,{CLEAR}但是有你帮忙的话,肯定没问题的！
strings.en: That’s great! The bikers are all really{NEWLINE}vicious Trainers, but with your help,{CLEAR}I’m sure it’ll be fine!
